channel.title: World Stock News | Real-Time Stock Market News & Financial Intelligence
channel.description: Institutional-grade stock market coverage, Wall Street analysis, real-time macroeconomic reports, and cryptocurrency intelligence.

item.title: In the battle for AI supremacy, China is only six months behind the U.S — but that means it’s winning, says former Google CEO
item.dc:creator: Elena Rostova
item.description: AI is not a bubble, says Google’s former CEO. It’s real growth, real money, real customers paying for something useful.

item.title: We have a $300,000 mortgage with a 2.75% interest rate. I want to pay it off. My husband says I’m crazy. Who’s right?
item.dc:creator: Marcus Vance
item.description: “I don’t want to enter retirement owing six figures when we have the cash to clear it.”

item.title: George Foreman’s lavish Texas estate with 50-car garage is listed for $6 million
item.dc:creator: Siddharth Mehta
item.description: The sprawling Texas estate where boxing legend George Foreman spent the final decades of his life has hit the market for $6 million—offering a rare glimpse inside the private world of the heavyweight champion.

item.title: My sister moved in with our mother, 78, and says she deserves the $925,000 family home. Is she right?
item.dc:creator: Claire Montclaire
item.description: “The house is worth $925,000 and mom owns it outright. She also has $480,000 in investments.”

item.title: Robot factories and hypersonic missiles: JPMorgan Chase's first $5 billion of defense investments
item.dc:creator: Elena Rostova
item.description: With $5 billion already deployed off its balance sheet, JPMorgan Chase is racing ahead on direct investments in defense tech, hardware and supply chains.

item.title: Tesla’s stock rises as Elon Musk drops new clues about a possible SpaceX merger
item.dc:creator: Elena Rostova
item.description: Special committees at both companies are assessing merger prospects but a combination is no sure thing, Musk says.

item.title: Why SpaceX’s stock is surging — and lifting the broader AI universe along with it
item.dc:creator: Siddharth Mehta
item.description: SpaceX just gave Wall Street a big reason to believe in the AI boom as demand for its computing power is off the charts.

item.title: Super Micro’s stock soars after surprise update — with Dell and HPE shares joining the rally
item.dc:creator: Elena Rostova
item.description: Super Micro unexpectedly disclosed that its revenue and profitability could be much stronger than originally anticipated.

item.title: Walmart takes aim at Amazon and Costco with new membership program — but is it a good deal?
item.dc:creator: Elena Rostova
item.description: Some analysts question whether people will actually take advantage of Walmart’s new bundle, and how easy it is to make sense of the benefits.

item.title: It’s no secret what the best financial advice for retirement is — but most people ignore it anyway
item.dc:creator: Marcus Vance
item.description: Research can prove a lot of facts, but that doesn’t mean it changes how people act.

item.title: Netflix vows to revive viewership trends, but investors hit ‘sell’ on the stock
item.dc:creator: Siddharth Mehta
item.description: Streaming service cites “intense competition’ and acknowledges ‘some investor concern about our view hours growth.”

item.title: Bull markets tend to peak with a whimper, not a bang — but a 15% correction for the S&P 500 may be next
item.dc:creator: Claire Montclaire
item.description: Unlike bear-market bottoms, which typically end with a spasm of despair as traders throw in the towel, bull-market tops are far more gradual and less dramatic.

item.title: The Social Security Administration corrected millions of records, and says there’s more to fix
item.dc:creator: Elena Rostova
item.description: In an effort to thwart fraud, the Social Security Administration said it has fixed millions of records and is working on correcting millions more.

item.title: Investors’ search for safety has made toothpaste stocks more expensive than tech
item.dc:creator: Elena Rostova
item.description: Wall Street is fleeing tech for toothpaste and shampoo. Even those stocks are getting expensive.

item.title: ‘I don’t feel sorry for myself’: I’m 64 and will be renting for the rest of my life — but here’s why I’m still hopeful
item.dc:creator: Marcus Vance
item.description: “Ill-timed circumstances can change our financial future in unexpected ways.”
